name: QuickBooks Online
description: Typed QuickBooks Online accounting resources, guarded sparse writes, bounded queries and financial report cells with exact decimal strings.

permissions.description: Fixed Intuit sandbox/production HTTPS Accounting API hosts; explicit company, external OAuth access token and write confirmation. No refresh or automatic retry. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Customer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Customer; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks List Customer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Customer; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Vendor (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Vendor; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks List Vendor (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Vendor; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Item (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Item; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks List Item (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Item; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Account (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Account; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks List Account (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Account; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Class (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Class; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks List Class (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Class; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Department (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Department; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks List Department (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Department; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Invoice (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Invoice; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks List Invoice (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Invoice; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Get SalesReceipt (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for SalesReceipt; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. definitions.name: QuickBooks List SalesReceipt (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for SalesReceipt; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Payment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Payment; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks List Payment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Payment; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Bill (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Bill; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks List Bill (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Bill; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks Get BillPayment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for BillPayment; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. definitions.name: QuickBooks List BillPayment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for BillPayment; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Get Purchase (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Purchase; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks List Purchase (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for Purchase; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks Get CreditMemo (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for CreditMemo; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks List CreditMemo (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for CreditMemo; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Get RefundReceipt (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for RefundReceipt; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. definitions.name: QuickBooks List RefundReceipt (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 list for RefundReceipt; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required.
