definitions.name: QuickBooks Report BalanceSheet (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 report for BalanceSheet; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Report TrialBalance (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 report for TrialBalance; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Report CashFlow (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 report for CashFlow; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Report GeneralLedger (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 report for GeneralLedger; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Report AgedReceivables (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 report for AgedReceivables; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Report AgedPayables (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 report for AgedPayables; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Report TransactionList (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 report for TransactionList; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/invoice https://medium.com/intuitdev/changes-to-our-accounting-api-that-may-impact-your-application-c330bd1a06f5 https://github.com/IntuitDeveloper/SampleApp-Batch-Java https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/minor-versions https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/request-and-response https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/workflows/run-reports https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/customer https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/vendor https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/item https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/account https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/class https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/department https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/salesreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/payment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/bill https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/billpayment https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/purchase https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/creditmemo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/refundreceipt https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/journalentry https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/estimate https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/companyinfo https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxcode https://developer.intuit.com/docs/api/accounting/taxrate

definitions.name: QuickBooks Invoice Changed (Relay) Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by QuickBooks Invoice Changed (Relay).
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for QuickBooks Invoice Changed (Relay). This trigger accepts the canonical version-1 quickbooks envelope only; it does not authenticate or decode native provider requests. Required exact provider verification: Verify intuit-signature as base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the exact notification payload with the environment-specific verifier token, authorize realmId and app/environment. Do not treat the verifier token inside a payload as authentication. Mapping: Split eventNotifications[].dataChangeEvent.entities[]. Map realmId to accountId, entity name/operation/id/lastUpdated into canonical envelope and assign deliveryId from verified notification identity plus realm/name/id/operation/lastUpdated. Multiple entities produce independent envelopes. Canonical eventType values: Invoice.Create, Invoice.Update, Invoice.Delete, Invoice.Void. Required envelope: version=1, provider=quickbooks, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. Notifications are change hints; separate read operations obtain current entity details. No full accounting document, PII, API mutation or company authorization is inferred. Sources: https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/webhooks https://static.developer.intuit.com/output_html/qbo/docs/develop/webhooks/configure-webhooks.html

ingressRequirements.name: QuickBooks entity notifications relay
ingressRequirements.description: Manual prerequisite: separately maintained exact provider authentication/normalization relay. This release only accepts header-authenticated canonical envelopes from that relay.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Verify intuit-signature as base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the exact notification payload with the environment-specific verifier token, authorize realmId and app/environment. Do not treat the verifier token inside a payload as authentication.

Split eventNotifications[].dataChangeEvent.entities[]. Map realmId to accountId, entity name/operation/id/lastUpdated into canonical envelope and assign deliveryId from verified notification identity plus realm/name/id/operation/lastUpdated. Multiple entities produce independent envelopes.

Implement the exact canonical version-1 envelope and typed resource schemas documented by each selected trigger; forward one event per POST. Normalize account identity from the authorized provider connection, never from an untrusted request.

Persist one stable delivery ID per logical event across relay retries. Fanout IDs must include distinct native entity/event/status identity (or a persisted record ID); reusing a batch delivery ID or message ID across different statuses drops events. Authorize account/resources; bound payloads to 64 KiB and limit rate.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-events"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
